The main underlying drivers of the USD NAV were negative public market and material events adjustments in the Fund of funds portfolio. · July saw negative net cash of $3 million with distributions of $11 million from the portfolio against $14 million of capital calls. · There were 46 M&A transactions and IPOs in the month, above the last 12-month average of 40. · The Distribution Pool balance was $259 million at 31 July. · During July, HVPE was in the market for 23 days buying back $8 million worth of shares. · Since the Board commenced share buybacks in September 2022, a total of $349 million has been bought back, adding 6.9% to NAV per share. Of this total, $292 million has been deployed under HVPE's Distribution Pool mechanism initiated on 1 st February 2024. HarbourVest Global Private Equity Limited ("HVPE" or the "Company"), a FTSE 250 investment company with global exposure to private companies, managed by HarbourVest Partners, today announces its estimated Net Asset Value ("NAV") at 31 July 2026. Realisation · HVPE received distributions of $11 million from HarbourVest funds during July 2026 (compared to $69 million of fund distributions in June 2026). The largest source of proceeds was related to a 2017 vintage global multi-strategy fund of funds' investment in Accel XI (primarily related to the investment in Circle Internet Financial), Lightspeed Venture Partners X (related to the sale of publicly traded shares of Navan and ServiceNow) and Lightspeed Venture Partners IX (related to the sale of publicly traded shares of Rubrik and Blend Labs). · During July 2026 there were a total of 46 realisations, with 39 M&A transactions and seven IPOs across HVPE's underlying portfolio (which is in line with June's total number of 46 realisations and above the 12-month average of 40). Distribution Pool · The Distribution Pool balance was $259 million at 31 July, which the Board has indicated will be utilised for a tender offer later this year as well as share buybacks for the foreseeable future. · Contributions to the Pool during July totalled $3 million, representing 30% of the cash distributions from HarbourVest funds received during the month. · HVPE was in the market for 23 days buying back shares in July. Over this time, 168,000 ordinary shares were repurchased for a total consideration of $8 million which resulted in a $0.03 accretion to estimated NAV per share. · From 1st February 2024 to 31st July 2026, the Company bought back $292 million of shares, representing 28% of gross distributions received (excluding secondary sales) during the period and adding 4.8% to NAV per share, while the share price increased by 44% over the same period. The Board is continuing to deploy cash from this Distribution Pool consistently month on month, believing that it will provide material benefits to shareholders over the long term. · Since the Board commenced share buybacks in September 2022, a total of $349 million has been deployed in this way, adding 6.9% to NAV per share. Balance Sheet and Credit Facility · At 31 July 2026, HVPE had $720 million available on its credit facility. · Borrowing at the HarbourVest fund level amounted to $524 million (13% of HVPE NAV), an increase of $6 million from the previous month. · HVPE's cash and cash equivalents ($140 million) and available credit ($720 million) totalled $860 million. · Net debt was $340 million or 8% of NAV. Weekly net asset value (“NAV”) is calculated as of the close of business on each Tuesday and posted on the following business day.
